commandPalette.title: Command palette
commandPalette.placeholder: Where do you want to go? Search or type a command …

start.subtitle: Everything that matters today at a glance.
start.firstAgentDescription: As soon as your first agent is working, you will see running tasks, pending approvals and time saved here.

errors.notFoundDescription: This page does not exist or no longer exists.
errors.unexpectedDescription: The error has been logged. Please try again.

auth.loginDescription: Welcome back. Sign in with your email address.
auth.useMagicLink: Sign in with an email link instead
auth.invalidCredentials: Email address or password is incorrect.
auth.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Please wait a minute.
auth.magicLinkFailed: The link could not be sent. Please check the address.
auth.magicLinkSentDescription: If an account exists for this address, we sent you a sign-in link. It is valid for 10 minutes.
auth.noSelfSignup: No account yet? Your administrator grants access by invitation.
auth.twoFactorDescription: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
auth.backupCodeDescription: Enter one of your backup codes.
auth.useAuthenticator: Use the code from the app

invite.title: Invitation to {tenant}
invite.invalidDescription: This link has expired, was already used or was revoked. Please ask for a new invitation.
invite.wrongAccount: You are signed in as {email}. Sign out and open the link again.
invite.existingAccount: An account already exists for this address. Sign in to accept the invitation.
invite.name: Your name
invite.passwordTooShort: The password needs at least {min} characters.
invite.signUpFailed: The account could not be created. Please try again.

selectTenant.title: Choose a company
selectTenant.description: Your account belongs to several companies. Which one do you want to work with?

noAccess.title: No access yet
noAccess.description: Your account is not assigned to a company yet. Ask your administrator for an invitation.

members.inviteDescription: The invitation is sent by email and is valid for 7 days.
members.removeConfirm: Really remove this person from the company?

audit.title: Audit log
audit.description: Every security-relevant change, immutable and chained with checksums.
audit.forbiddenDescription: Only owners and admins can see the audit log.

branding.title: Branding
branding.description: Your company colour for {product}. We derive a light and dark palette from it that meets the accessibility contrast rules (WCAG).
branding.adjusted: For good readability we use {color} instead of the chosen colour.
branding.invalid: Please enter a colour in the format #RRGGBB.
branding.forbiddenDescription: Only owners and admins can change the branding.

security.title: Security
security.description: Policies that apply to everyone in your company.
security.requireLabel: Require two-factor authentication for owners and admins
security.requireHint: Whoever manages the company must also confirm the sign-in with a code from an authenticator app. Without setup they cannot continue.
security.selfHint: You have not set up two-factor authentication yourself. After saving you will be asked to do so.
security.forbiddenDescription: Only owners and admins can change the security policies.

partner.title: Partner console
partner.subtitle: All customers of {partner} at a glance
partner.createDescription: The owner immediately receives an invitation by email. Setup takes less than a minute.
partner.name: Company name
partner.listDescription: You see administrative data here – none of your customers' content.
partner.pricingDescription: Model prices of the AI provider (purchase) and the rate used to show costs to your customers in euros.
partner.priceUnit: US dollars per million tokens. New prices are added as a database row with a validity date (table price_tables).
partner.rateHint: For example the ECB reference rate, with a currency buffer if you like. Leave empty to show costs in US dollars.

chat.emptyDescription: Your assistant drafts texts, answers questions and calculates exactly.
chat.example1: Write a friendly payment reminder for an invoice of €1,250.
chat.example3: Write a short appointment confirmation for Tuesday, 9 am.
chat.placeholder: Write a message … (Shift+Enter for a new line)
chat.disclaimer: AI-generated answers can contain mistakes. Please check important details.
chat.notConfigured: No AI provider is set up yet. Your administrator adds the access in the configuration.
chat.statusRefused: The agent declined this request for safety reasons.
chat.statusFailed: The agent could not complete the task.
chat.statusBudget: This agent's cost limit was reached.
chat.statusMaxSteps: The step limit was reached. Please split the task.
chat.statusApproval: The agent is waiting for an approval.

account.title: Account and security
account.subtitle: Your personal account, independent of the company.
account.requiredNotice: Your company requires two-factor authentication for owners and admins. Please set it up now; afterwards everything works as usual.
account.name: Name
account.twoFactorDescription: In addition to your password you confirm the sign-in with a code from an authenticator app (e.g. Microsoft Authenticator or Google Authenticator).
account.wrongCode: The code is incorrect. Please use the current code from the app.
account.setupStep1: Open your authenticator app and scan the QR code (or enter the key).
account.setupStep2: Store the backup codes in a safe place – they get you in if your phone is missing.
account.setupStep3: Enter the 6-digit code from the app to finish the setup.
account.qrAlt: QR code for the authenticator app
